去北京吗？
对。

nǐ xué Yīngyǔ ma?

No, (I) study Chinese.

明天见！

bú qù. qù yínháng qǔ qián.
míngtiān jiàn!
míngtiān jiàn!

No. Going to the bank to withdraw money.
See you tomorrow!
See you tomorrow!
